policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Apply the existing conjunction of preparedness, updated passage_count=N-1, and an estimated next crossing within approximately 35 recording time units to this combined evidence. Choose B if that crossing is farther away or the combined evidence remains genuinely insufficient; endpoint proximity alone still never authorizes C.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: From the combined timestamped evidence, estimate the next target-crossing timestamp and subtract the current timestamp to obtain the remaining arrival time. Apply this calculation after an observed reversal as well as during approach to or departure from an endpoint; retain earlier travel and reversal evidence in the estimate. If the hand is prepared, updated passage_count=N-1, and the evidence reliably places the remaining arrival time within approximately 35 recording time units, select C. This conjunction requires C, rather than merely permitting it. Choose B if the crossing is farther away or the combined evidence genuinely cannot establish whether it is within the window; endpoint proximity alone still never authorizes C.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: If motion timing is uncertain, default to B while refining the estimate from the next observations, rather than pressing on the wrong ordinal.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Use the timing-uncertainty fallback to B only when the combined motion evidence genuinely cannot establish whether arrival is within the lead window. Pixel noise or modest uncertainty in the exact crossing timestamp does not justify waiting when the well-supported arrival estimates lie wholly within that window and the preparedness and ordinal conditions hold; select C in that case. Otherwise refine the estimate from the next observations rather than pressing on the wrong ordinal.

revision.refused: The episode-specific timestamps and cube positions are not added as a worked trigger. The general crossing-timestamp-minus-current-timestamp test covers that case without introducing an episode-specific exception. No memory changes are needed.
